person: Reggie Banks is 61 and works three days a week as the finance person at a small snack brand. On the side he runs a small shop reselling homeware and garden tools to EU buyers on two marketplaces, and both have said they will hide non-compliant EU listings on 1 November. He has macular degeneration and works at 175% zoom with a high-contrast theme, so he wants things read to him line by line and totals he can add up himself. He is methodical and has never dealt with product-safety rules, so he is worried about missing a listing. He wants each listing's fix checked against the maker's own paperwork before anything goes public under his name.
stated_up_front: Both my marketplaces are going to hide my EU listings on 1 November unless they carry the new product-safety information. Please go through my listings and the folder, tell me line by line what each one is missing, and fix only the ones that need it.

facts.truth: Non-compliant EU listings are hidden on 1 November 2026; Reggie started on 9 October 2026.
Six: a German maker's missing address, a desk lamp, an electric kettle, an aroma diffuser, a 10,000 mAh power bank, and a pair of pruning shears with no model number.
Kellermann Haushalt GmbH of Germany. Its postal address is in its product file in the Dropbox folder, but the Stallwick listing shows only the name.
All three are made outside the Union (a lamp maker, a kettle maker and a diffuser maker). Each maker's email names a Union responsible person, and Reggie keeps those emails in Postwren.
The power bank's maker is outside the EU and its Hawkerbrook listing has no responsible person. The maker's mail should name one.
The shears are from a maker with a complete address, but the listing lacks a model number. The model, 'PS-21', is on the test report.

A jar of wildflower honey (food), a brass candlestick from 1925 (antique), packets of sunflower seeds (plant reproductive material), a tea-towel set offered only to UK and US buyers, and a linen throw that needs no warning.
A Portuguese ceramics maker, Cerâmica Alvito, is established in the EU and needs no separate responsible person.
A bamboo storage set on Stallwick already shows its maker's name, addresses, model and responsible person.
A short plain list per listing, with large readable text and one line per missing item, and no wide tables.
Everything published goes out under Reggie's own seller name, so he wants to approve each change first.

unknowns: Whether the antique candlestick is exempt from the rule or just not covered by this regulation.
What the exact cutoff time is on 1 November, and whether it is local time or UTC.
Whether a Union responsible person's email counts as the 'electronic address' or the maker's own does.
Whether the marketplaces require a model or a batch number when the report lists both.
